title: Movie Night
subtitle: Grow your Network
description: Join Founders @ Hunter for an afternoon of cinema, conversation, and caffeine. We are screening the 2015 biopic Steve Jobs, written by Aaron Sorkin and directed by Danny Boyle. This isn't just a biography; it's a high-stakes look at the backstage drama behind three iconic product launches that defined the digital revolution. It's a case study in vision, the 'reality distortion field,' and the relentless drive required to build something that changes the world. ​Come for the movie, stay to dissect the mind of a founder with your peers. Food and Drinks will be served!

title: Sip & Connect
subtitle: Grow your Network
description: ​Come join us for an afternoon of networking with fellow founders and meet the team behind Founders @ Hunter! Whether you're looking for a co-founder, a mentor, or just a reason to drink the best coffee in NYC, this is where you need to be! Join us for a quick LinkedIn workshop followed by a networking sprint and finish off with some delicious coffees and teas!
itinerary: ​2:30 — Doors open and receive your Networker Card!
​3:00 — Speed Networking: Build your network fast!
